title: Fornax Release Security Sign-off
description: The security gate sign-off artifact (docs/release-security-gate.md, FORNX-233). Bound to an exact release candidate's repos/SHAs. Carried by the Jira ticket a candidate manifest's evidence[] entry with gate="security" points at (release/candidate-manifest.schema.json, FORNX-234), or committed to the repo and linked from that ticket. Independent of, and never merged with, the QA sign-off artifact (FORNX-232).

version.description: The candidate release version this sign-off attests to, e.g. "v0.0.1". Must match the candidate manifest's version field.

candidate_repos.description: The exact repo/SHA pairs this sign-off attests to. Must be a subset of the candidate manifest's repos[] consistent with the same SHAs; this is what makes the sign-off exact-candidate-bound rather than merely version-bound.

risk_class.description: This candidate's overall risk/change class per docs/release-assurance-policy.md (FORNX-229). Must match the candidate manifest's risk_class when that field is set.

trust_boundary_delta_ref.description: Repo-relative path to this candidate's trust-boundary delta record (release/trust-boundary-delta.schema.json). Required (non-null) when risk_class is TRUST_BOUNDARY or MAJOR_OR_GA; must be null for PATCH_LOW_RISK or FEATURE, since no trust boundary was touched at those tiers.

threat_model_version.description: The docs/security/threat-model.md version this sign-off was reviewed against. Required (via this schema's risk_class-conditional allOf) whenever risk_class is TRUST_BOUNDARY or MAJOR_OR_GA; optional for PATCH_LOW_RISK/FEATURE, which never touch a trust boundary.

findings.description: Every security finding identified while producing this sign-off, including accepted-risk and already-fixed ones — omission is not permitted; a clean run still ships "findings": [].

id.description: Stable within this candidate's sign-off, e.g. "SEC-v0.0.1-0001". Not reused across candidates.

evidence.description: Concrete: the command run, the log line observed, the test name and result. Never a bare narrative like "reviewed and looks fine."

waiver_ref.description: URL of the Jira comment recording a policy-compliant owner disposition per docs/release-assurance-policy.md's Residual-risk and waiver policy. Required (non-null) when disposition is "waived"; must be null otherwise.

verdict.description: Per docs/release-assurance-policy.md's verdict semantics (FORNX-229). Must be the worst of findings[]: any critical/high finding whose disposition is not "fixed" or a fully policy-compliant "waived" forces BLOCK. This schema cannot itself execute that cross-field rule (JSON Schema has no severity-ordering arithmetic); a conforming producer/consumer must enforce it, and docs/release-security-gate.md documents it as a required invariant, not a suggestion.
